children: Dell Technologies completed a public offering of $5.0 billion of senior unsecured notes through subsidiaries Dell International and EMC. The issuance includes $1.25B of 5.100% notes due 2029, $1.25B of 5.400% notes due 2031, $1.5B of 5.600% notes due 2033, and $1.0B of 5.900% notes due 2037, issued under a base indenture and series-specific supplemental indentures. The notes are guaranteed by Dell Technologies, Denali Intermediate, and Dell Inc., and include standard investment-grade covenants and change-of-control protections. The financing enhances the company’s liquidity and debt management flexibility.
